premise.claim: Since ubuntu-latest started resolving to the ubuntu-26.04 runner image, the E2E Functionality Check workflow fails on all 5 Kubernetes versions: the JindoRuntime FUSE container cannot mount (fusermount3: mount failed: Permission denied). Pinning kind-e2e-test to ubuntu-24.04 restores green CI.
premise.reportedComponent: CI workflow .github/workflows/kind-e2e.yml (job kind-e2e-test); failure surfaces in test/gha-e2e/jindo (JindoRuntime FUSE pod)
premise.evidence: Run 40474966878 (PR #6219, label ubuntu-latest) ran on image ubuntu-26.04 v20261012.163.1 and failed all 5 matrix jobs: jindo-demo-jindofs-fuse pod CrashLoopBackOff, diagnostic artifact log shows 'fusermount3: mount failed: Permission denied' for FLUID_FUSE_MOUNTPOINT=/jfs/jindofs-fuse. The same PR's earlier run 40125302787 ran on image ubuntu-24.04 v20261012.334.1 and passed all 5. This PR's own run 40885813005 (head fa06ee36) passes all 5 kind-e2e-test jobs on label ubuntu-24.04. See results/.

liveNote: Live layer intentionally skipped for this review (CI-workflow-only change; the PR's own GitHub Actions run 40885813005 is the live evidence). To re-check the underlying runner problem after the real fix for #6224 lands: run the E2E Functionality Check workflow on an ubuntu-26.04 runner and confirm the jindo suite passes (no fusermount3 EACCES in the jindofs-fuse pod log).
